doc.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Singing and goodbyes
summary: Moody on musicians singing, then thanks and goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I don’t know about that. But musicians, you know people always say why do musicians think they can sing? Well I’m not a balladeer. But at least I can say [scats] You know what I mean? I can hum my intervals and sing. So that’s why I think I can [scats]. You know what I mean. Here’s one [scats]. You know that one, right? Put a fourth on there.
Man I’ve got to take this tape home now and have a saxophone lesson.
Well follow those intervals. All right. Well thanks so much for your time. I hope you keep us informed when you come out east.
Can I get a hug? Thanks, Monk.
